products.title: Totem - Rainforest Mayumbe
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
Totem Mayumbe fragrance diffusers are available in 5 liters, 2 liters and Mini Totem. Their handblown opaline glass is sprinkled with colors in shades of blue and saffron, making this diffuser a truly decorative object. It bears a white enameled ceramic stopper, made by our Portuguese craftsmen. Their perfume with notes of cinnamon wood and galbanum will take you to the magic of the African forest after which they are named.

FRAGRANCE

Cinnamon Wood - Cedar - Nutmeg Its perfume with notes of cinnamon wood and galbanum will take you to the magic of the African forest after which they are named.

products.title: Totem - Rainforest Tanjung
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
Totem Tanjung perfume diffusers are large opaline bottles in which subtle colors ranging, from browns to roses, elegantly adorn the glass.

FRAGRANCE

Galbanum - Gaiac Wood - Crumpled Leaf Hand-blown by our glass craftsmen, the Totem Tanjung diffusers are a truly decorative object whose fragrance with notes of cedar, Guaiac wood and galbanum will enchant your interiors.

products.title: Totem - Rainforest Amazonia
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
Totem Amazonia fragrance diffusers are available in 5 liters, 2 liters and Mini Totem. Their opaline glass with shades of blue, turquoise and brown are topped with a white ceramic cap, fi nished with reactive glazes, handmade by our Portuguese artisans.

FRAGRANCE

Bergamot - Green tea - Musk Now more than ever, the Amazonia Totem will be decorative objects that enchant your interiors with a vegetal and mysterious perfume.

products.title: Totem - Feathers Touareg
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
The hand-made cobalt blue ceramic cap adorns the Totem Feathers Touareg bottle with an imaginary turban similar to those worn by the “blue men” of the desert.
The opaque white glass is hand-blown with blue confetti details encrusted to give off a feather effect on the glass.
250ml | 8.4fl.oz | 5.9in
2L | 67.6fl.oz | 10.83in
5L | 169fl.oz | 14.57in

FRAGRANCE

Mint - Jasmine - Mate Its perfume is a blend of tea and fresh mint that will take you to the depths of the Sahara desert to meet the nomadic tribes that inspired it.

Adorned with a shiny black and white ceramic cap, Totem Feathers is a unique and decorative object to introduce into your interiors.

Black Rose - Oud Wood - Saffron Its perfume is woody with notes of delicate black rose, an ode to the male-female duality.

products.title: Totem - Les Exclusives Roseum
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
The Totem Roseum perfume diffuser is a beautiful decorative object finished with a ceramic stopper enameled in a gunmetal color. The object thus becomes a jewel and brings an extraordinary shine to your interiors. Both festive and timeless, its refined fragrance will fill your home with a wave of femininity and delicacy. Roseum will also be available as a refillable 500ml perfume diffuser.

FRAGRANCE
Both festive and timeless, its refined fragrance will fill your home with a wave of femininity and delicacy.

products.title: Totem - Sand Siloli
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
The Totem Siloli diffuser, available in 2 and 5 liters, is finished with a brown and beige handmade ceramic stopper that matches the colors of the glass. It claims its place in an interior as a unique and refillable decorative object.

FRAGRANCE
The dry woody fragrance of cedar and tonka bean takes us to the wide-open spaces of an equatorial climate, with a touch of lime to give this fragrance an unusual fresh-ness. The sophistication of the olfactory materials is in perfect harmony with that of the glass, striking a beautiful balance between decorative and perfumed object.

products.title: Totem - Sand Sonora
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
Available in 250ml, 2 and 5 liters Totem perfume diffusers, these decorative objects, allunique, become works of art imbued with the sophistication of glass work.

FRAGRANCE
The spicy scent is reminiscent of the cinematic setting of the Mexican desert after which these items are named. A creative blend of saffron, myrrh and patchouli spreads warm, spicy notes throughout your home.


USE
Place all the sticks in the tank and let the diffusion take place. Turn the sticks over if you want to increase the intensity of the fragrance diffusion.

products.title: Totem - Stones Lazuli
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
The Totem Lazuli perfume diffusers’ glass references the magic of the blue stones from which it draws its name. Their cobalt and old gold ceramic caps add a precious effect to the bottles. Objects of decoration as 2 liters or 5 liters bottles, it becomes a more intimate accessory as a 250 milliliters bottle.

FRAGRANCE
Their perfume is a sophisticated alliance of musk, cardamom, and sea salt, a sense of escape that fills your interiors.

products.title: Totem - Sand Atacama
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
The Totem Atacama scent diffuser are refined objects perfect for urban and chic interiors. Available in 250ml, 2 and 5 liters.

FRAGRANCE
A citrusy fragrance with a major accord of bergamot, followed by aromatic heart notes and myrrh as a base note.

products.title: Totem - Stones Agate
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
The Totem Marble diffusers are hand-blown by our glass artisans. In reference to the color scheme of precious marble, their ceramic caps are black and silver in accordance with the bottles. If the allure of Totem Marble is majestic in 2 liters or 5 liters, it becomes a precious object and collector item 250 milliliters that will match all your interiors.

FRAGRANCE
Its leather perfume diffuses an olfactory identity simultaneously seductive and masculine.

USE
Place all the sticks in the tank and let the diffusion take place. Turn the sticks over if you want to increase the intensity of the fragrance diffusion.

products.title: Totem - Les Exclusives Aurum
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
Resembling a jewel worn by your interiors, the Totem Aurum fragrance diffuser is hand-painted by our glass artisans with a precious gold tint. A tricolored ceramic cap sits atop the bottle, a nod to the dexterity of our ceramic artisans who are masters of an array of glazing techniques.

FRAGRANCE
Its perfume is a subtle blend of sambac jasmine and musk, a voyage that combines the lightness of Asia with the mystery of the Middle East.

products.title: Totem - Les Exclusives Cyprium
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
The Totem Cyprium fragrance diffuser joins the Aurum and Platinum Totems in a majestic fashion. Its ceramic cap’s design will be the common element in this new copper-colored edition. 

FRAGRANCE
The woody perfume with notes of sandalwood will present itself like an olfactory delicacy with a mysterious twist.

products.title: Totem - Les Exclusives Platinum
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
The Totem Platinum diffuser will be a precious object in your interiors, as it references the metal from which it draws its name. The glass, hand-blown by our glass artisans, is delicately painted with a platinum tint.

The glazed ceramic cap, both matte and bright, is delicately decorated with a lozenge motif that references tribal patterns.

FRAGRANCE
Its grapefruit and amber perfume is a step into a world both fresh and masculine.

products.title: Totem - Pearls White
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
The Totem White Pearls diffuser’s glass contains white and powder pink details. Our glass artisans’ dexterity means that each bottle is one of a kind. Its matte white ceramic cap, sculpturally alluring, can delicately be placed on the bottle as an adornment that gives it a refined presence.

FRAGRANCE
Its perfume is a soft blend of white musk and freesia that will embalm your interiors in a discrete and feminine fashion.

products.title: Totem - Pearls Black
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
Hand-blown by glass artisans, the glass is decorated with black and iridescent details that reference black pearls of the Pacific Ocean. The decorative and sculptural cap is made from glazed ceramic with a graphic relief, an unexpected twist that gives the bottle a tribal and ornate quality.

FRAGRANCE
The Black Pearls’ perfume is a fresh and sophisticated blend of ginger and black rose.
